**M = Me · P = Partner · J = Joint**  
**Keep this checklist and the essentials in the car, not the moving truck.**

## Pack in the car
- [ ] **J** Documents: IDs, passports, lease or closing papers, vehicle title, and vital records
- [ ] **M** Medications: prescriptions for both people, plus a few extra days’ supply if available
- [ ] **M** Dog kit: harness or crate, leash, ID tag, food, water, bowls, waste bags, meds, rabies/vet records, and familiar blanket
- [ ] **P** Tech: phones, charging cables, car charger, and charged power bank
- [ ] **J** Keys and wallets: car keys and spare, new-home keys or access code, cash and cards
- [ ] **P** Road snacks and drinking water
- [ ] **P** Basic toolkit: screwdriver, pliers, scissors, tape, and flashlight
- [ ] **M** Car kit: insurance card, registration, first-aid kit, tire gauge, and jumper cables or jump starter
- [ ] **P** Printed phone list: mover/driver, landlord or agent, hotels, emergency contact, roadside assistance, and emergency vet

## Mover handoff
- [ ] **P** Keep the estimate, signed bill of lading (BOL), and inventory in the car
- [ ] **J** Check the inventory, note existing damage, and confirm the delivery address and window before signing; never sign blank forms

## Before you leave
- [ ] **J** Sweep rooms, closets, cabinets, garage, and outdoor areas; check windows and doors
- [ ] **P** Photograph each room’s condition and the final meter readings
- [ ] **P** Return old keys, fobs, and remotes; get a receipt
- [ ] **M** Secure the dog in a travel harness or crate before pulling out

```python
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.pdfbase.pdfmetrics import stringWidth

TITLE = "MOVING DAY ESSENTIALS — OHIO → OREGON"
LEGEND = "M = Me · P = Partner · J = Joint"
NOTE = "Keep this checklist and the essentials in the car, not the moving truck."
FOOTER = "Keep this in the car — NOT the moving truck."

PACK = [
    ("J", "Documents: IDs, passports, lease or closing papers, vehicle title, and vital records"),
    ("M", "Medications: prescriptions for both people, plus a few extra days’ supply if available"),
    ("M", "Dog kit: harness or crate, leash, ID tag, food, water, bowls, waste bags, meds, rabies/vet records, and familiar blanket"),
    ("P", "Tech: phones, charging cables, car charger, and charged power bank"),
    ("J", "Keys and wallets: car keys and spare, new-home keys or access code, cash and cards"),
    ("P", "Road snacks and drinking water"),
    ("P", "Basic toolkit: screwdriver, pliers, scissors, tape, and flashlight"),
    ("M", "Car kit: insurance card, registration, first-aid kit, tire gauge, and jumper cables or jump starter"),
    ("P", "Printed phone list: mover/driver, landlord or agent, hotels, emergency contact, roadside assistance, and emergency vet"),
]

HANDOFF = [
    ("P", "Keep the estimate, signed bill of lading (BOL), and inventory in the car"),
    ("J", "Check the inventory, note existing damage, and confirm the delivery address and window before signing; never sign blank forms"),
]

WALKTHROUGH = [
    ("J", "Sweep rooms, closets, cabinets, garage, and outdoor areas; check windows and doors"),
    ("P", "Photograph each room’s condition and the final meter readings"),
    ("P", "Return old keys, fobs, and remotes; get a receipt"),
    ("M", "Secure the dog in a travel harness or crate before pulling out"),
]

def wrap(text, width, size):
    line = ""
    for word in text.split():
        trial = f"{line} {word}" if line else word
        if line and stringWidth(trial, "Helvetica", size) > width:
            yield line
            line = word
        else:
            line = trial
    if line:
        yield line

def make_pdf(filename, width, height, pocket=False):
    if pocket:
        margin, gutter, body, leading, box, gap = 13, 12, 8.2, 10.2, 11, 5
        title_size, heading_size, footer_size = 9.8, 9, 6.5
    else:
        margin, gutter, body, leading, box, gap = 38, 27, 12, 16, 16, 13
        title_size, heading_size, footer_size = 20, 14, 8

    pdf = canvas.Canvas(filename, pagesize=(width, height))
    pdf.setTitle(TITLE)
    pdf.setLineWidth(1)
    col_width = (width - 2 * margin - gutter) / 2
    y = height - margin - title_size

    def text(x, baseline, value, size, bold=False):
        pdf.setFont("Helvetica-Bold" if bold else "Helvetica", size)
        pdf.drawString(x, baseline, value)

    # Draw the arrow directly so it prints without an extra font.
    left, right = TITLE.split(" → ")
    text(margin, y, left, title_size, True)
    ax = margin + stringWidth(left + " ", "Helvetica-Bold", title_size)
    ay, al = y + title_size * 0.32, title_size * 0.65
    pdf.line(ax, ay, ax + al, ay)
    pdf.line(ax + al, ay, ax + al * 0.67, ay + al * 0.24)
    pdf.line(ax + al, ay, ax + al * 0.67, ay - al * 0.24)
    text(ax + al + title_size * 0.24, y, right, title_size, True)

    y -= leading + (3 if pocket else 6)
    text(margin, y, LEGEND, body, True)
    y -= leading
    for line in wrap(NOTE, width - 2 * margin, body):
        text(margin, y, line, body)
        y -= leading
    top = y - (4 if pocket else 13)

    def column(x, entries):
        y = top
        tag_x = x + box + (4 if pocket else 6)
        text_x = tag_x + (10 if pocket else 15)
        for entry in entries:
            if isinstance(entry, str):
                text(x, y, entry, heading_size, True)
                y -= leading + (4 if pocket else 7)
                continue
            tag, wording = entry
            pdf.rect(x, y + body * 0.72 - box, box, box)
            text(tag_x, y, tag, body, True)
            lines = list(wrap(wording, x + col_width - text_x, body))
            for i, line in enumerate(lines):
                text(text_x, y - i * leading, line, body)
            y -= max(len(lines) * leading, box) + gap
        return y

    bottom_left = column(margin, ["Pack in the car", *PACK[:8]])
    bottom_right = column(
        margin + col_width + gutter,
        [*PACK[8:], "Mover handoff", *HANDOFF, "Before you leave", *WALKTHROUGH],
    )
    assert min(bottom_left, bottom_right) > margin + footer_size
    pdf.setFont("Helvetica", footer_size)
    pdf.drawCentredString(width / 2, margin, FOOTER)
    pdf.showPage()
    pdf.save()

make_pdf("moving-day-letter.pdf", 612, 792)
make_pdf("moving-day-pocket-4x6.pdf", 288, 432, pocket=True)
```
